admission_gate_gaps.description: Wiki delta tracker — SHA-256 per content block
Phase 7 promotion — schema + registry validation + audit log
RocksDB event store append — JSON serialize, no content hash in value
admission_gate_gaps.gap_reason: RocksDB internal block-level checksums already protect against on-disk corruption. A per-value cryptographic commitment would catch RAM corruption or malicious writes but is not currently in the threat model.

admission_gate_gaps.description: RocksDB verdict cache put — JSON serialize, no content hash
admission_gate_gaps.gap_reason: Same as event store: RocksDB block checksums cover disk corruption. Verdict cache entries are regeneratable from the LLM; corruption is recoverable.

admission_gate_gaps.description: Z3 SAT admission check for parametric constraints
TypeScript daemon contract file — writes JSON without a signature
admission_gate_gaps.gap_reason: Python reads this file and trusts its contents. A truncated or corrupt write would silently produce wrong spatial results. Adding a SHA-256 or BLAKE3 footer would let the Python reader detect integrity failures.

decision_gate.notes: BLAKE3 at 1MB: 0.7x vs SHA-256. 1 medium+ open admission-gate gap(s). Decision: GO_GAP.
